description: Create one illustrated article using the permitted execution location. Hosted projects run in SupportPages with configured repositories/models; never launch a local writer for a hosted operation. Local responses return the existing prepared writer task. Defaults to draft even if project auto-publish is enabled. Set publish only for an explicit user publication request. Reuse request_id when recovering a lost response.

request_id.description: Use a new UUID for a new intentional request, and reuse it for recovery. Omitted reuses the saved identical request.

name: supportpages_create_article
